thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated SSL/TLS handshake failures reported from multiple CF POPs for api.redwood.ai — ~28% failures across us-central and eu-1 edge groups in last 4m. Paging sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: ack — looking now.
lee: I see spikes in 524/525 and intermittent TLS timeouts in the edge logs starting ~15:02 UTC. Errors cluster around a subset of Cloudflare terminators.
rachel: customers pinging support about aborted streaming sessions and auth failures. Getting a few high-severity tickets.
sre-oncall: quick checks: `dig api.redwood.ai` returns CF anycast IPs. `openssl s_client -connect <cf-ip>:443 -servername api.redwood.ai` shows TLS handshake starts but then client sent an alert on some IPs.
eng-infra: origin health is green. Direct curl to origin OK. No recent cert changes on our side; origin cert still valid.
cloudflare-support-bot: Ticket opened with Cloudflare: #CF-22245. We uploaded sample edge logs and handshake traces. CF investigating potential config roll.
lee: thought: can we shift traffic to our backup CDN or flip Cloudflare proxy off briefly? Risk: lose WAF and caching. Benefit: immediate restore to customers.
sre-oncall: short mitigation plan: 1) lower DNS TTL and prepare gray-cloud (disable proxy) changes for affected names; 2) prepare origin autoscale handoff; 3) customer comms draft. If CF confirms rollout pause, might reenable later.
product-ops: draft status blurb: "Intermittent TLS errors affecting API reachability in US/EU edge locations. We are mitigating by routing traffic directly to origin while Cloudflare investigates. No data loss; some streaming sessions may need retry." Approve?
customer-success: yes, send to top-tier customers + post to status page. Add recommended retries and SDK backoff guidance.
eng-infra: prepping autoscaling: bump instance count and increase connection limits. Watch origin CPU/RPS.
sre-oncall: initiating gray-cloud flip for a small canary subset (us-central pop) at 15:08 UTC. Will monitor for 5m before broader changes.
lee: metrics: canary saw errors drop from 30% -> 4% within 40s. p95 latency steady.
rachel: CS reporting some customers regained connections. Support queues still handling churn.
cloudflare-support-bot: CF update: we observed an SNI rotation in a recent deploy that caused mismatches on a slice of edge terminators. Rollout paused and fixes are being pushed. Advising bypass for immediate customer recovery.
sre-oncall: rolling gray-cloud for eu-1 pop at 15:14 UTC.
eng-infra: note: enabling direct origin increases TLS connections at LB. Keep an eye on ephemeral port exhaustion. We pre-warmed additional workers.
product-ops: posted status: "Mitigated — traffic temporarily routed direct to origin for affected edge regions while Cloudflare addresses edge TLS regression. Investigating impact and follow-up postmortem to be published."
cloudflare-support-bot: CF: fix deployed to control plane; edge rollout in progress. We will coordinate re-enable once rollout is validated.
sre-oncall: current state: proxy disabled for affected pops, global success rate back to baseline ~0.9% error. Keeping short-term mitigation in place for 30m.
customer-success: scheduling customer calls for any high-severity partners who experienced streaming interruptions.
lee: follow-up action: implement automated failover that detects >10% TLS/525 across regions and triggers DNS gray-cloud canary with guardrails. File created: FOL-420.
sre-oncall: assigning follow-up to eng-infra and SRE docs: create runbook and automated rollback logic.
eng-infra: will own follow-up. Also propose adding synthetic TLS checks from multiple regions to detect similar regressions earlier.
product-ops: will compile timeline and customer communications for postmortem.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2. Auto-ticket INC-2026-043 created.
sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall in 20m — @lee will take over. Leaving thread open until CF confirms safe re-enable.
lee: taking handoff at 15:28 UTC. Notes: CF ticket #CF-22245, proxy=off for kansas/eu-1 canopies, origin autoscale active, status posted. Monitoring link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/edge-tls-checks.
cloudflare-support-bot: final CF note (15:33 UTC): incremental rollout continues. Recommend customers re-enable proxy only after CF confirms stable on all POPs. CF will provide RCA.
sre-oncall: closing active mitigation steps. Postmortem required; will draft and attach logs to CF ticket. End of thread.
